mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in planning and building a secondary dwelling unit?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an on-site consultation to evaluate your property's layout, existing plumbing, electrical capacity, and intended use. Next, design plans and architectural drawings are drafted to establish the floor plan, utility connections, and exterior finishes, such as matching existing stucco. Once plans are finalized, necessary building permits are submitted to the local building department. After permit approval, construction proceeds through foundation work, framing, rough-in plumbing and electrical, insulation, drywall installation, and final interior fixture installation before final inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves an initial site consultation, design planning, local permitting, structural framing, utility rough-ins, drywall installation, and final interior finish work.
